template.name: BlueMap 3D Web Map
template.description: Generates interactive 3D maps of your Minecraft worlds served over a built-in web server. Installs BlueMap 5.29 (Paper) with asset download accepted and configures the web server port.

variables.label: Web Server Port
variables.description: TCP port BlueMap listens on. Add an extra allocation in the Network tab and enter its port here.

variables.label: Render Threads
variables.description: Number of CPU threads BlueMap uses to render map tiles.

variables.label: Enable Built-in Web Server
variables.description: Serve the 3D map directly from BlueMap's integrated HTTP server.

steps.name: Write BlueMap core config
steps.content:
## BlueMap core configuration
accept-download: true
data: "bluemap"
render-thread-count: {{ render_thread_count }}
metrics: true

steps.name: Write BlueMap web server config
